summary: The positive-dimensional tensorization theorem is correct: the section argument covers both proper and all-space sections, the lifted-halfspace bounds are valid, and independent maximizing sequences remove all attainment assumptions. The descendant computation follows exactly from the accepted two-cap gadget and equal-weight fiberwise Minkowski construction; the piecewise upper profile is concave, all real and integer fibers are correct, and the mixed mass is 29/8. The halfspace audit at the proposed template center and the pointwise reverse audit cover every orientation, integer layer, interval endpoint, and transition value, proving exact maximum depth 3/2. Product-measure identification, the base-preserving unit-fiber-determinant shear, normalization, and both WO/CD implications have the stated constants and quantifiers, including arbitrary positive integer and continuous dimensions.
